operating_notes.text: HCG launched a new comprehensive cancer hospital in Hebbal, North Bengaluru, with up to 132 beds and a built-up area of 1,75,086 Sqft.
HCG launched HCG Cancer Hospital, Hebbal (up to 132 beds) with an investment of approx ₹129 Cr, funded via debt and internal accruals.
BACC Health Care was classified as a disposal group held for sale, with a goodwill impairment of ₹31.91 Cr recognized in Q4FY26.
HCG completed its rights issue raising ₹425 Cr, oversubscribed by 1.3x.
FY26 adjusted EBITDA grew 19% to ₹471.1 Cr with margins at 18.5%, supported by capacity utilisation and throughput.
Q4 FY26 revenue growth was impacted by intentional paring down of low-margin business and Middle East conflict affecting medical value travel.
Q1FY27 in-patient volume was 78,914, up 11% YoY, with ARPP of ₹85,943, up 2%.
Non-institutional payor mix rose to 69% in Q1FY27 from 67% in Q1FY26.
North Bengaluru hospital had 56 operational beds and contributed ₹6.7 Cr revenue in its first quarter.

timeline.summary: HealthCare Global Enterprises Limited scheduled an earnings conference call on May 20, 2026, at 1:30 PM IST to discuss Q4 & FY2026 audited results.
CARE Ratings issued the Monitoring Agency Report for HCG's ₹424.68 Cr rights issue for Q4FY26 with nil deviation.
HCG announced the launch of a new 132-bed comprehensive cancer hospital in Hebbal, North Bengaluru, featuring Karnataka's first MR-Linac.
HCG launched its new 132-bed comprehensive cancer hospital in Hebbal, North Bengaluru, with an investment of ~₹129 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹652.33 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹2.17 Cr.
HCG approved the divestment of its entire equity shareholding in BACC Health Care Private Limited for ₹37.64 Cr.
HCG reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹652.33 Cr up 11% YoY and announced the divestment of its fertility business Milann.
HCG reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,545.4 Cr (+15% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of ₹471.1 Cr (18.5% margin).

Sunu Manuel, Director of Healthcare Global Enterprises Limited, announced the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 audited results on May 20, 2026, available at https://www.hcgoncology.com/investor-relations/
Dr. Manish Mattoo relinquished charge as Interim CFO on May 25, 2026, upon Sanjeev Kumar assuming office as CFO.
Healthcare Global Enterprises reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹652 Cr and announced the divestment of its fertility business Milann.
Q1FY27 (Aug 6, 2026): HCG reported 13% YoY revenue growth to ₹695 Cr and adjusted EBITDA margin of 19.4%, with 121 operational beds added including 56 at the new North Bengaluru hospital.
HealthCare Global Enterprises Limited scheduled an earnings call on **November 6, 2026, at 12:30 PM IST** to discuss unaudited Q2 & H1 FY27 results with senior management.
